title: Schedule of Late Charges — Northgate Business Invoice Accounts (Net Terms)
content:
**Schedule of late charges, Northgate Business Invoice Accounts (Net Terms).** The late charge is a charge per month on past-due invoice balances, stated as a percent, with a smallest charge for any month in which a charge is due; an invoice counts as past due for late charges only after the tier's grace days have passed since its due date.

| Terms tier | Late charge per month (percent) | Smallest late charge in a month in which any is due (USD) | Grace days after the due date | Courtesy waivers in any rolling 12 months |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Northgate Business Net 15 | 1.5 | 5.0 | 5 | 1 |
| Northgate Business Net 30 Standard | 1.5 | 5.0 | 5 | 1 |
| Northgate Business Net 30 Preferred | 1.5 | 5.0 | 5 | 2 |
| Northgate Business Net 45 Volume | 1.5 | 5.0 | 10 | 2 |
| Northgate Business Net 60 Enterprise | 1.5 | 5.0 | 10 | 2 |
| Northgate Business Net 30 Public Sector | 0.0 | 0.0 | 30 | 0 |

**Footnotes common to every tier**

1. *Basis.* The balance the late charge is computed on is the past-due invoice principal at statement date, as simple interest.
2. *Rounding.* Late charges and early-payment discounts are rounded half up to the cent.
3. *No charge.* A late charge per month of 0.0, as on Net 30 Public Sector, means no late charge; that tier's smallest charge and courtesy waivers are likewise 0.
4. *Grace days* are calendar days after the due date before an invoice counts as past due for late charges.
5. *Courtesy waivers* are the late charges that may be waived as a courtesy in any rolling 12 months.

**Rounding illustration (hypothetical figure).** A charge computed at $7.125 is rounded half up to $7.13; one computed at $7.124 is rounded to $7.12.
